text.p: Transbrasil Airlines, one of South America's leading carriers, has launched a new route linking London Gatwick with Brazil.
The new four times a weekly round trip-service which started from Gatwick on Monday November 25, alternates between Recife or Salvador and continues onto Rio de Janeiro and Sao Paulo.

"We are delighted to bring one of South America's leading airlines to the UK. We forecast strong demand in this market," said Transbrasil general manager for the UK and Ireland, Victor Faria in a statement.
Brazil's economy continues to grow and there us a strong demand for business travel from London to both Rio and Sao Paulo.
"There is also tremendous opportunity to capitalise on the growth in tourism to Brazil's North-East based on the cities of Recife and Salvador," he added.
Transbrasil's 21 aircraft fleet comprises Boeing 767-300/300ER, 200/200ER and 400. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
